narr: Scattered thunderstorms associated with a surface trough produced heavy rain which caused flash flooding across portions of eastern and southeast Virginia.
ev: Flash flooding was reported in the Courthouse area of Liberty Square.
Lane closures were reported due to high water on Route 168 near the Virginia North Carolina border.
lsr: FLOODING IN THE COURTHOUSE AREA OF LIBERTY SQUARE.
LANE CLOSURES DUE TO HIGH WATER ON ROUTE 168 NEAR THE VA/NC BORDER. REPORT FROM SOCIAL MEDIA.
